text:
Osaka has three Christmas markets this December.
One is free, in a park, with 24 shops 👇

🎯 Guess which one has a Santa House, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/osaka-christmas-markets-2026

🎄 Tenshiba, Tennoji Park: free entry.
20 Nov–25 Dec, 11:00–21:00.
Hot drinks are ¥100 cheaper in the market mug.

🎄 Umeda Sky Building: free to walk in.
A tree of about 25 m and 130,000 LEDs.
Light show every half hour, 17:00–21:30.

🎄 Hankyu Umeda, 9th floor:
about 120 brands and an 8 m mirror-ball tree.
The event-hall part ends on 20 Dec.

✅ Our take: Tenshiba for a full market night.

👉 The Showa-style street under the 25 m tree:
